reason: $24.99 launch price for a first box is low enough to try, and the lab report behind the QR code plus the empty-box refund takes most of the risk out. Pre-counted sachets are handy when I am on the road twice a month.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and I will not know if magnesium does anything for me until I have finished the box. I also only get the launch price on the first box, so I will compare what it costs per day before I ever reorder.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger discount on the second box, or a one-capsule dose, would get me to reorder.
